messages:
matt: FYI — customer (acme-ml) escalated: embeddings endpoint shows periodic tail-latency spikes after we enabled dynamic batching with max_batch_size=128. 99p goes from ~120ms to ~3s in a sawtooth pattern every ~25–35s.

jess: Can you paste the client request + runtime config? Any recent model changes? :mag_right:

matt: No model change. Client sends batches of mixed small/large texts. Example call:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-v1","input":["short","a much longer paragraph ... repeated ...","short2"]}'
```
Server config snippet (customer):
```
{"dynamic_batching":true, "max_batch_size":128, "batching_timeout_ms":50}
```

sophia: Seeing that config, probable cause is large padding overhead and batching window interaction. Logs from their shard:
```
[11:03:12] batcher DEBUG created_batch id=7 size=1 padded_tokens=3072 wait_ms=48
[11:03:12] worker INFO process_batch id=7 latency_ms=3120
[11:03:37] batcher DEBUG created_batch id=8 size=64 padded_tokens=256 wait_ms=12
[11:03:37] worker INFO process_batch id=8 latency_ms=130
```
Pattern: occasionally a single huge request enters a window and forces tiny batches with massive padding => tail spike.

lucas: Repro steps I used locally (quick):
- start a loop that sends one large (8k tokens after encoding) item every 30s
- in parallel send bursts of 50 small items
- run with max_batch_size=128 + batching_timeout 50ms
Observed identical 3s spikes and a gap correlation to the large item arrival.

jess: Could this be exacerbated by per-client priority tags causing single-item batches to be isolated? Also check if prefix/KV cache warms differently for big vs small.

sophia: Good call — logs show priority=normal for small, priority=high for the large request which made it bypass coalescer. That created solitary batch with huge pad.

matt: Steps to mitigate for customer:
1) reduce max_batch_size -> 32
2) lower batching_timeout_ms -> 15
3) disable priority bypass for that client or set priority=normal
4) recommend client to split extremely long inputs or provide approximate token_length hint

ops-bot: Created support ticket INC-2026 and scheduled a canary config rollout to the customer's dedicated pool.

lucas: After we tweaked to max_batch_size=32 + timeout=15ms in canary, 99p dropped to ~180ms in 30-minute run. Need a longer run but promising.

matt: I'll send patch to customer and ask for a 24h validation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: If it recurs we'll add auto-detection: if padded_tokens > threshold then force split or reject with clear error.

jess: Also add a dashboard panel for padded_tokens per shard so SRE can alert earlier.

sophia: Filed follow-up RFC to add token-hint header to SDKs so clients can opt-in to better batching decisions.

matt: Closing loop here — follow-ups tracked in INC-2026. :white_check_mark:
